text:
🐾 Welcome to BeanTown Tzu Crew! 🐾

Boston’s Shih Tzu community just got a little fluffier. 🤎

We’re a community for Shih Tzu lovers across Boston and beyond, created to celebrate these little personalities, connect their humans, and give our pups a place to be their adorable selves.

Whether your Tzu is a city pup, a professional couch potato, a tiny troublemaker, or the mayor of your neighborhood, they’re part of the crew. 🐶

And we want to get to know them!

✨ Want your Boston Shih Tzu to have a spotlight?
DM us a photo, their name, age, and a little bit about them!

We’ll be sharing our Tzu Crew members right here, so follow along and meet the faces (and floofs!) that make up BeanTown Tzu Crew. 🐾🤎

#BeanTownTzuCrew #BostonShihTzu #BostonDogs #ShihTzuBoston #BostonDogCommunity
